description: For admins: server status, setup checks, core integrity and the enabled apps. Steps an account without admin rights cannot run are reported as failed. Sequence (built in): runs these steps in one call, as you: 1. system_status; 2. run_setup_checks; 3. check_core_integrity; 4. list_apps. Steps whose tool you do not have are skipped. Pass dryRun: true to see the resolved plan without running it.

dryRun.description: Resolve and validate the steps, but run none
